result.instructions: Solar Studio Module 01. Deterministic flat-site table layout: validate_request, calculate_row_pitch, create_project/get_project/update_project, generate_layout, get_layout_summary, get_layout_items, export_layout. All coordinates are metres in the request frame (x East, y North). Do not invent quantities; read them from results.

tools.description: Validate and normalize a layout request. Returns typed field errors or the normalized request, table dimensions and candidate bounds. Persists nothing.

request.title: solar.layout.request/1
request.description: Flat-site layout request in an explicitly named metric Cartesian frame (x East, y North, metres). Structural rules only: geometry validity, the supported envelope, frame semantics and pitch feasibility are checked after this schema by the application and reported as typed field errors.

kind.description: local_cartesian or projected_cartesian; other values are rejected as UNSUPPORTED_FRAME.

crs.description: Required for projected_cartesian. Retained verbatim; no transformation is performed.

units.description: Must be "m"; other values are rejected as UNSUPPORTED_FRAME.

length_m.description: Long side (>= width_m). Supported envelope 0.05..10 m.

power_wp.description: Nameplate STC power; the only electrical rating used.

columns.description: Modules across the table width (along u).

module_gap_x_m.description: Gap between columns, in the table plane.

module_gap_y_m.description: Gap between rows, in the table plane.

facing_azimuth_deg.description: Clockwise from frame north; normalized to [0, 360).

lower_edge_height_m.description: Synthetic height of the lower edge above the layout's relative flat datum.

row_pitch_m.description: Lower edge to lower edge, horizontal, along v.

position.description: [x, y]. A third (Z) value is rejected after this schema as UNSUPPORTED_INPUT.

tools.name: validate_request

tools.description: Limited 2D row-spacing estimate at ONE specified solar elevation (flat ground, equal heights, infinite rows, sun perpendicular to rows). Not an all-year shading guarantee or energy estimate.

request.title: solar.row_pitch.request/1
request.description: Limited two-dimensional row-spacing estimate at one specified solar elevation. Solar azimuth, dates and time windows are not accepted by this release (UNSUPPORTED_INPUT).

table_slope_length_m.description: Table length L up the slope, in the table plane.

solar_elevation_deg.description: Supplied elevation, (0, 90]. Elevations below the declared minimum are refused with a bounded diagnostic.

axes.convention: u = (-cos A, sin A), v = (-sin A, -cos A); A clockwise from frame north

computation_frame.forward: x_local = x_world - origin_x; y_local = y_world - origin_y
computation_frame.inverse: x_world = x_local + origin_x; y_world = y_local + origin_y

geometry_policy.admissible_region_display: site.buffer(-setback) minus union(exclusion.buffer(keepout)), round joins, 64 segments per quarter circle; used for display and buildable area only, never for placement decisions
geometry_policy.borderline: float distance margins within 1e-09 m of the requirement are re-decided exactly with rational arithmetic on the represented coordinates
geometry_policy.buildable_area_bounds: lower bound uses arc radius r/cos(pi/(4*q)) (polygon outside the true arc), upper bound uses chords on the true arc
geometry_policy.computation_frame: world coordinates translated by the placement anchor (x_local = x_world - anchor_x); no rotation or scaling of the site
geometry_policy.containment: a complete table footprint must be covered by the site polygon (GEOS covers, exact predicate); tangency to the boundary is allowed
geometry_policy.exclusion_keepout_positive: minimum Euclidean distance from the footprint to the exclusion polygon must be >= keepout_m
geometry_policy.exclusion_keepout_zero: footprint and exclusion interiors must be disjoint (GEOS relate, exact predicate); touching is allowed
geometry_policy.partial_tables: never; an inadmissible table is dropped whole
geometry_policy.serialization: shortest round-trip decimal (Python repr) for every float; -0.0 written as 0.0
geometry_policy.setback: minimum Euclidean distance from the footprint to every site boundary ring (outer and holes, all components) must be >= perimeter_setback_m
